# Requirements Quality Checklist: Settings and First Run

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the English of the 004 spec — completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability and coverage of the settings, first-run, key-storage, language, Test connection, autostart and http-warning requirements (FR-13, FR-14, FR-15, FR-19, FR-21, FR-29; NFR-04, NFR-10) before planning
**Created**: 2026-10-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Defaults applied (no interaction possible): depth Standard · audience reviewer of the spec and plan · focus clusters: validation and save atomicity, secrets (NFR-04), language/catalog (FR-15), first run (FR-21). Items marked `[x]` were resolved by the generating agent in this run (spec checked or edited, note inline); open items need the owner, another feature's spec or the plan. The owner/reviewer may re-open any of them.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is every setting named in req FR-13 placed on a tab with its owner stated (including download/deletion hosted from 002)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Boundaries] — yes.
- [x] CHK002 Are the first-run defaults listed for every setting, including those req FR-21 does not name (microphone, post-processing, engine base URLs/models)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005] — resolved: post-processing defaults now stated (off, empty endpoint/model/key, 003's starter prompt).
- [x] CHK003 Are all entry points that open the settings window enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002] — resolved: second-instance launch (001 FR-002) and the "no local model" action (002 FR-011) added.
- [x] CHK004 Is a validation rule stated for every field that can be invalid (URLs, models, key, local model, hotkey, N, prompt)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK005 Are failure requirements stated for every side effect of a save (file write, key store, autostart entry, hotkey registration)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, §FR-016, §FR-019, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK006 Is a rollback order defined when a save fails after some side effects already succeeded (e.g. hotkey re-registered, then the key store refuses)? [Gap, Spec §FR-003] — resolved in plan: research R-3 orders the steps (validate → hotkey prepare → autostart → keys → file → commit) and undoes in reverse; double failure documented.
- [ ] CHK007 Is the behaviour defined when the hotkey or mode is changed while a recording is in progress (hold-mode release of a hotkey that has just been released by the save)? [Gap, Spec §FR-008, Dependency on 001] — open: needs 001/owner.
- [x] CHK008 Is the handling of a settings file written by a newer app version (downgrade) or an older schema (upgrade migration) specified beyond "unknown schema version → reset"? [Gap, Spec §FR-010] — resolved in plan: research R-2 (missing fields default, newer schema → backup + reset).

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK009 Is "malformed URL" defined (absolute http/https with a host; trimming; trailing slash)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Edge Cases] — the same rule covers the post-processing endpoint (closes 003 CHK010).
- [x] CHK010 Is "local host" for the http warning defined, including IPv6 and letter case? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020] — resolved: `localhost` in any case, `127.x.x.x`, `::1`; LAN addresses warned (Assumptions).
- [x] CHK011 Is it clear which base URLs trigger the warning — all stored ones or only those in use? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-020, §US6] — resolved: only the selected engine's URL and the post-processing endpoint while it is on.
- [x] CHK012 Is "takes effect without restart" defined per setting? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK013 Are the Test connection outcomes mapped to precise conditions (DNS/refused/connect timeout → cannot reach; 401/403 → invalid key; total timeout → timeout)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK014 Is "OS language" defined (Windows display language, any `ru` variant, unreadable → English)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK015 Is the set of hotkey keys allowed as the non-modifier key specified (e.g. are F-keys alone without modifier, Win-reserved combinations, or Space-only allowed)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004] — resolved in plan: research R-6 lists the closed key set.
